contact.location: University of Miami, Coral Gables, FL

stations.name: Richter Library
stations.why: Long study sessions drain phones, and nobody wants to give up a good seat to hunt for an outlet.

stations.name: Shalala Student Center
stations.why: The crossroads of campus. Students pass through between classes, so it is the easiest place to grab a charger or drop one off.

stations.name: Merrick Building
stations.why: Back-to-back classes leave no time to sit by an outlet. A station on the way into class solves it in seconds.

stations.name: Whitten Learning Center
stations.why: A classroom building on the far side of campus from the lake, so students there don't have to cross campus to return a charger.

stations.name: Herbert Wellness Center
stations.why: Music, workout tracking and the walk home all run on a phone that has already been through a full day of class.
